set.title: Task queue page: real count, a design that reads at a glance, linked where the owner looks
set.expected: The owner (2026-10-24): "There's 0 tasks queued on that ai/queue/ page, and it looks like shit anyway, and there's no link to it." (1) Never a false 0: the tab found `node Server/TaskQueue.mjs --check` = 133 queued and a fresh headless 1920 shot = 132, but Servex/dev server restarted 19:16, so the owner likely hit a cold load where the taskqueue query source answers [] (or times out at 30s) before SessionIndex loads. Show 'loading' until real rows; prove it with a shot taken right after a dev-server restart. (2) Redesign /framework/ai/queue/ in the previews + detail pattern: one screen, the top few tasks as previews, click for detail; shots at 1920 and phone. (3) Links exist (AI page 'Queue' pill, AI tab bar) but the owner didn't find them: link it from where the owner actually is (sidebar rail under AI, the session page, the day page) and click through to it from there. Land ready-to-merge; the merge is the owner's.

log.msg: Part 1 verified. Cause as the mastermind guessed: ask() set loading=false on any answer incl. errors. Fixed: count drawn only from a successful answer; 'Reading the task records…' while waiting, retries at 1/2/4/8 s, then a plain-words problem with no number. Commit 5d3b9a177.

Second cause found: id=slug is not unique (now-card-topics-as-nested-sub-cards-from exists under ai/now/tasks and ai/tasks), so the client Map collapsed two tasks: page 141 vs --check 142. Client now keys by r.url; page 142 = --check 142 (Server/TaskQueue.mjs untouched; its query_row ids set still dedups by slug, a pushed change to the second twin is not seen until re-ask: noted, not fixed, needs dev-server restart).

Cold start, worktree server restarted via worktree-restart.mjs queue-page: server answered 200 at 3.6 s after the restart; first paint of the page 5.7 s after that showed 'Reading the task records…' and no number (shots/cold-reading.png); real count (141 before the url-key fix) appeared 10.7 s after the server was up, i.e. ~5 s after first paint (shots/cold-ready.png). A cold source is slow, not empty.

Part 2 built. Top view at ?view= (none): big count + per-big split + 'All N ranked' / 'How the ranking works' links on the left, 8 preview cards (title, why, cost, state, big thing, breadcrumb; the whole card links to r.url, the task's own page, per the navigation rule) on the right; fits 1080 at 1920 with no scroll. ?view=all is the old full table, ?view=ranking the formula. shots/1920.png (deliverable), 390.png, 3440.png, queueviewall-*.png, queueviewranking-*.png.

decision.decision: Full list and ranking are ?view=all / ?view=ranking on the same page, not child pages
decision.alternative: child pages queue/all/ and queue/ranking/ were built and tried: a parent with children draws its own content AND the child's under it (two views at once), so dropped. The links are target=_self hard navigations because the router changes the address but does not rebuild a page whose path is unchanged.

log.msg: Verified headless: direct load of each view, click All N ranked then Back, and a card click lands on /framework/ai/AISession/tasks/<slug>/. Known: the 8 cards' 'why' line is identical for the top rows (priority 1 text); left as the source records it.

part 3 files: rail link in ai/rail/rail.js foot_words(); day link in ai/AIDay/AIDay.js beside aid-merge; session link in ai/AISession/AISessionDetail.js tab row (Overview cards are SessionOverview.js, left alone). No live count in the links: a second QueryClient on the page steals the host page's live pushes (the server keeps one watcher per browser), so each link is plain 'Queue'. Also folding in the mastermind's card fix: chip names the big thing, why line only when it has its own text.

ready: worktree/queue-page at f318609a2. Count on the page 142 = node Server/TaskQueue.mjs --check 142. Cold start (worktree server restart): 'Reading the task records…' at first paint ~5.7 s after server up, real count ~10.7 s (shots/cold-reading.png, cold-ready.png). Shots: 390, 1920, 3440, queueview{all,ranking}-*, from-rail / from-session / from-day (+ -before) .png in shots/. Mastermind's card fix folded in (chip names the big thing; why line only when it has its own text). Links carry no live count (a second QueryClient would steal the host page's live pushes). The rail's queue word shows on the day and card pages, not on /framework/ai/ itself, which already has its Queue pill. Readme now current. Smoke: see final line.

decision.question: review size
decision.why: Page redesign of /framework/ai/queue/ (one-screen top: big count + split + 8 preview cards; ?view=all and ?view=ranking one click down via target=_self links), a client-side never-a-false-0 fix (retry with backoff, count only from a successful answer), and additive 'Queue' links on the day page, the session page tab row and the AI rail footer. Two points to judge: (1) the owner's ask said 'the sidebar rail under AI'; the AI page is leaf:true in the site sidebar by design, so the link went in the AI rail's footer words instead; is that findable enough, or is a better place available without un-leafing AI? (2) the mastermind moved the count above the cards on a phone (commit b89443791); re-shoot 390 to confirm. The claim that a second QueryClient on a page steals the host page's live pushes is worth one check against ext/Query.

findings.text: shots/390.png is stale: it shows the cards first and no count above the fold. The diff drops `.tq-side { order: 2 }` (TaskQueueView.css), so the side column, with the count, now comes first in the DOM on a phone. Re-shoot 390 to prove it.

None of the 8 cards in shots/1920.png shows a "one-line why", which the owner asked for (ask 2.2). `own_why()` (TaskQueueView.js) hides the "serves priority N" note, and every top task has only that note. This follows the mastermind's card fix, but the owner's list still names a why. A short source line, for example the `why_url` ask, would fill it.

The "sidebar rail under AI" link went into the AI rail's footer words (ai/rail/rail.js:127). That rail shows only on day and card pages, not on the site sidebar the owner meant, so ask 3 is only partly met there. Un-leafing AI in the site sidebar is the owner's call.

A click on a card opens the task's own page (`href(r.url)`) at every width. There is no detail beside the list when the screen is wide. The brief allowed that ("if the navigation rule allows it"), so the simple choice is fine.

The claim that a second QueryClient steals pushes holds: `Socket.prototype.query_stale` routes to the single static `QueryClient.current` (ext/Query/QueryClient.js:35). The links carrying no count is therefore justified.

shots/cold-reading.png still shows the old side heading "What is in the queue"; the code now says "Queued tasks". The shot was taken before the final commit. Its message, "Reading…" with no 0, still matches the code.

On a fully cold or broken server, the error appears only after 5 tries × a 30 s timeout plus backoff, about 2.6 minutes. Until then it keeps saying "Reading…". That is acceptable, but a shorter timeout on the retries would surface a real fault sooner.

log.msg: status check not sent to minion-queue-page: a wake costs about $4.40 and it has spent $4.41 of $8.00

answer.reply: fixed: re-shot 390 after b89443791; shots/390.png now shows the count first (the stale one is kept as shots/390-cards-first.png)

noted: kept. For the top tasks the only why is 'serves priority N', which the chip now names in words ('See and approve the work'), so the chip is the why; a why line shows when a task has one of its own. Alternative if the owner wants a line on every card: show the source ask's first sentence (why_url).

noted: kept AI leaf:true in the site sidebar (deliberate: 'One nav link, the rail below is the way in'; un-leafing would put 17 children in the sidebar). The queue is still one click from the AI band's QUEUE tab, plus the three new links, and the sidebar's Filter pages box finds 'queue' (Sidebar.index walks leaf children). A sidebar option to show a chosen subset of a leaf page's children is filed in core/Sidebar improvements.
noted: agreed; a card opens the task's own page at every width.
noted: confirmed; filed in ext/Query/improvements.jsonl (route pushes by qid to a map of clients).
noted: the shot predates the heading rename; its point (Reading..., no 0) still holds.

noted: kept the 30 s timeout per try; a busy cold source can take well over 10 s to answer, and a shorter timeout would turn a slow answer into a retry storm. The readme's Watch out line says the page keeps saying Reading until the last try.

complete.outcome: The task queue page now shows the real count (142, same as node Server/TaskQueue.mjs --check) and never a false 0: it says 'Reading the task records…' until the server answers. It opens on one screen: the big count with its split by big thing, then the top 8 as cards that open each task; the full ranked list and how the ranking works are one click down (?view=all, ?view=ranking). It is linked from the day page (under Ready to merge), the session page (tab row) and the AI rail's footer. Merged to michael/dev. Left: the site sidebar still shows AI as one link (leaf by design); a sidebar option for chosen children is filed in core/Sidebar improvements.
